title: 19-BCV-017 - Vented soffit protection

facts.text: The variance concerns Part 9 buildings requiring solid/unvented soffits because of their location or projections in areas of concern.

An intumescent-coated vented fiberglass or metal substrate may be an alternative if an SCC-accredited laboratory tests it to perform at least as well as 11 mm plywood under the source’s stated test criteria.
facts.locator: 19-BCV-017 PDF, pp. 3–4, Variance and Appendix A

facts.text: Installation must follow manufacturer instructions or the testing documentation.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
